text:
“BAYOU SPIN — HIPPO SURGE ATTACK”

This one didn't follow the prompt but came out really well until the end!! Some hallucinations are not so bad. 

Don't you think??

Seedance 2 prompt:

A small airboat ride in a Louisiana bayou turns into uncontrollable chaos when a rogue hippo uses shallow water and mud to hunt at high speed. The scene is humid, loud, unstable — camera constantly reacting, never in control.

⸻

Prompt (≈330 words, Detailed + Timestamps)

SETTING (LOCKED)
Louisiana bayou, late afternoon turning to dusk, golden-orange light reflecting off still water, Spanish moss hanging from cypress trees, thick humidity, insects in air, shallow muddy water with reeds and roots, narrow water channels.

⸻

0s–2s (HOOK)
Camera already mounted low on the side of an airboat, skimming fast across shallow swamp water. The prop engine ROARS loudly. Water sprays across lens. Suddenly — the water ahead BULGES violently — a massive hippo head bursts partially out of the surface directly in the boat’s path. The driver jerks the wheel hard — camera whips sideways.

⸻

2s–5s
Handheld chaos inside the airboat. Metal rattling. A passenger nearly falls as the boat fishtails through reeds. Behind them — the water is no longer flat — it’s breaking in a fast-moving line. The hippo is already charging beneath the surface, keeping pace.

⸻

5s–8s
Camera swings rear-facing. The hippo erupts halfway out of the water, mouth wide, pushing a wall of mud and water forward. The boat hits a patch of shallow mud — slows for half a second — dangerous pause.

⸻

8s–11s (CONTROLLED CHAOS)
The driver forces the throttle — engine SCREAMS — the boat spins partially sideways before catching traction. Camera dips low — almost hitting water — spray floods frame. The hippo veers slightly, then cuts direction sharply, re-aligning.

⸻

11s–15s (PAYOFF)
The boat bursts into a slightly wider open patch of water. For a split second — space.

Then the water right beside the boat ERUPTS upward again — massive force, close enough to shake the entire frame violently.

Camera spins, horizon lost.

Cut hard.

⸻

Key Visual Hook

A hippo bursting up directly in front of a speeding airboat within the first second.

⸻

Why It Will Go Viral

Unstable camera, unpredictable movement, and the idea that the creature is faster than the boat in shallow water creates constant tension with no safe moment.
content: A small airboat ride in a Louisiana bayou turns into uncontrollable chaos when a rogue hippo uses shallow water and mud to hunt at high speed. The scene is humid, loud, unstable — camera constantly reacting, never in control.

translations.es: Un pequeño paseo en hidrodeslizador por un pantano de Luisiana se convierte en un caos incontrolable cuando un hipopótamo rebelde utiliza el agua poco profunda y el barro para cazar a alta velocidad. La escena es húmeda, ruidosa, inestable — la cámara reacciona constantemente, nunca está bajo control.
translations.fr: Une petite promenade en hydroglisseur dans un bayou de Louisiane se transforme en chaos incontrôlable lorsqu'un hippopotame en liberté utilise les eaux peu profondes et la boue pour chasser à grande vitesse. La scène est humide, bruyante, instable — la caméra réagit constamment, jamais sous contrôle.
translations.ja: ルイジアナの湿地帯での小さなエアボートの旅が、浅瀬と泥を利用して高速で狩りをする暴れカバによって制御不能の混乱に陥る。シーンは湿気があり、騒がしく、不安定で、カメラは常に反応し、決して制御されていない。
translations.ko: 루이지애나의 늪지에서 작은 에어보트 여행이 통제 불가능한 혼란으로 변합니다. 한 마리의 반항적인 하마가 얕은 물과 진흙을 이용해 고속으로 사냥하기 때문입니다. 장면은 습하고, 시끄럽고, 불안정하며 — 카메라는 끊임없이 반응하고, 결코 통제되지 않습니다.
translations.pt-BR: Um pequeno passeio de aerobarco em um pântano da Louisiana se transforma em um caos incontrolável quando um hipopótamo rebelde usa a água rasa e a lama para caçar em alta velocidade. A cena é úmida, barulhenta, instável — a câmera reage constantemente, nunca está sob controle.
translations.zh-CN: 在路易斯安那州的沼泽中，一次小型气垫船之旅变成了无法控制的混乱局面，一只流氓河马利用浅水和泥浆高速狩猎。场景湿热、嘈杂、不稳定——摄像机不断反应，从未掌控局面。
